confirmed_facts.text: The Polisario Front's National Secretariat declared a state of general mobilisation on 10 November.

international_perspectives.text: A Morocco-based outlet dismissed the declaration as rhetoric and said it gave no details on locations, units or measures.

unknowns: Whether mobilisation translates into military action

update_history.summary: Draft prepared for editorial review (sources accessed 23 November 2026).

title: Polisario Front declares general mobilisation as UN Western Sahara mission winds down
observed_action: On 10 November 2026 the Polisario Front's National Secretariat declared a state of general mobilisation, citing Moroccan military movements, as the UN mission MINURSO is being withdrawn.
interpretation: A significant political signal after the end of the UN mission, but no clashes had been reported in the sources reviewed; it does not by itself establish imminent large-scale fighting.
summary: The Polisario Front declared a general mobilisation against Morocco on 10 November 2026 following the end of the UN peacekeeping mission's mandate in Western Sahara.
impact_assessment: Potential: renewed armed confrontation along the berm and further strain on Morocco–Algeria relations.
priority_rationale: MODERATE: a confirmed mobilisation announcement in a frozen conflict without observed escalation.
monitoring_actions: Watch for reported clashes along the berm
Follow UN statements on MINURSO's withdrawal
